Messages.Author: Reyda
Messages.Body:
Hi !
i had a little rule problem.
If you dodge a strike, the additional effects of the strike are ignored, huh
?
but some effects still apply...
We all know that "minion gets -1 hand damage" from bonecraft is ignored if
you dodge, but the "press" from a thrown sewer lid is still there.
Now what about kraken Kiss ? the superior version allows you to get a press
AND steal blood as a strike for the remainder of combat. what if it is
dodged ? you still get the press and special ability for remainder of combat
?
and now, imagine opposing vampire plays "combat ends". You stick with him by
"telepatic tracking". Is the Kraken kiss ability activated, since majesty is
supposed to negate other strikes ?

by the way, we had a problem tonight....
I had a bomb on Huang. I chose it for my strike but opponent played combat
ends. Is the bomb burned ? i think not but...
i think there was a ruling on this : grenades and bombs are not burned if
combat ends.

please help me out !

reyda

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
In article <9435ar$1nvh$1...@news5.isdnet.net>,

"Reyda" <re...@noos.fr> wrote:
> If you dodge a strike, the additional effects of the strike are
> ignored, huh ?

The additional effects on your minion are ignored.
This is all.

Rulebook sec 6.4.5 Strike Effects
http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/rulebook/rulebook.html#sec6_4_5
"Dodge only cancels effects that are directed at the dodging minion."

> but some effects still apply...

Everything that doesn't affect your minion is still available
to the player of the strike.

> We all know that "minion gets -1 hand damage" from bonecraft is
> ignored if you dodge, but the "press" from a thrown sewer lid is
> still there.

Correct.

> Now what about kraken Kiss ? the superior version allows you to
> get a press AND steal blood as a strike for the remainder of combat.

And it will do the same thing if it is dodged.
In RPG terms it shouldn't, but this is a CCG, and the
second + round effects of the card are not tied to the
strike hitting the opposing minion the round it is played.

> what if it is dodged ? you still get the press and special ability
> for remainder of combat ?

Yes.

> and now, imagine opposing vampire plays "combat ends". You stick
> with him by "telepatic tracking". Is the Kraken kiss ability
> activated, since majesty is supposed to negate other strikes ?

The additional effects of the card are still available.
Strike: combat ends doesn't negate the opponents strike card,
it negates any effect it might have on the minion playing the
Strike: Combat Ends.

> by the way, we had a problem tonight....
> I had a bomb on Huang. I chose it for my strike but opponent played
> combat ends. Is the bomb burned ?

No.
You never get to regular strike resolution, so the bomb has no chance
of going off and doesn't get used. You have announced your intention
to use the bomb as your strike, you haven't used it for a strike.

> i think not but...
> i think there was a ruling on this : grenades and bombs are not
> burned if combat ends.

This is correct, but was not a ruling, merely a clarification of the
timing of strike resolution. This is also covered in 6.4.5 strike
effects.

Carpe Noctem.

The Lasombra <TheLa...@hotmail.com> wrote:
> "Reyda" <re...@noos.fr> wrote:
> > If you dodge a strike, the additional effects of the strike are
> > ignored, huh ?
> The additional effects on your minion are ignored.

Correct.

> > Now what about kraken Kiss ? the superior version allows you to
> > get a press AND steal blood as a strike for the remainder of combat.
>
> And it will do the same thing if it is dodged.
> In RPG terms it shouldn't, but this is a CCG, and the
> second + round effects of the card are not tied to the
> strike hitting the opposing minion the round it is played.

Correct.

> > what if it is dodged ? you still get the press and special ability
> > for remainder of combat ?
>
> Yes.

Correct.

> > and now, imagine opposing vampire plays "combat ends". You stick
> > with him by "telepatic tracking". Is the Kraken kiss ability
> > activated, since majesty is supposed to negate other strikes ?
>
> The additional effects of the card are still available.
> Strike: combat ends doesn't negate the opponents strike card,
> it negates any effect it might have on the minion playing the
> Strike: Combat Ends.

Not true. Since the Kraken's Kiss strike never resolved, none
of its effects are applied.

> > by the way, we had a problem tonight....
> > I had a bomb on Huang. I chose it for my strike but opponent played
> > combat ends. Is the bomb burned ?
>
> No.
> You never get to regular strike resolution, so the bomb has no chance
> of going off and doesn't get used. You have announced your intention
> to use the bomb as your strike, you haven't used it for a strike.

Correct. Even if you continue the combat with TT, the bomb is
still not burned, since the strike doesn't resolve. This parallels
the Kraken's Kiss case.

Messages.Author: Joshua Duffin
Messages.Body:
In article <9445bu$ort$1...@nnrp1.deja.com>,

LSJ <vte...@white-wolf.com> wrote:
> The Lasombra <TheLa...@hotmail.com> wrote:
> > "Reyda" <re...@noos.fr> wrote:
> > > If you dodge a strike, the additional effects of the strike are
> > > ignored, huh ?
> >
> > The additional effects on your minion are ignored.
>
> Correct.

For the sake of completeness - so are effects on equipment on
the minion. Sabbat War rulebook, 6.4.5:

"A dodge strike deals no damage, but it protects the dodging
minion and his possessions from the effects of the opposing
strike. Retainers are not protected, however."

Fast Hands (Shattering Blow, etc.) can be tragically ineffective
against celerity-based weapons decks. (As long as they didn't
have to use the maneuver on a gun, anyhow.)

Josh
